customManagers.description: Track elastic/beats branch HEAD — currentValue is derived from baseBranch at runtime

packageRules.description: Ignore elastic/beats v7 - requires manual update
Track elastic/beats branch HEAD and regenerate go.mod pseudo-version via make generate
Group AWS SDK packages together
Group Azure SDK packages together
Group GCP packages together
Group Kubernetes packages together
Group golang.org/x packages together
Group Elastic packages together
Group Trivy packages together
Group google.golang.org/genproto packages together
Group OpenTelemetry packages together

Group the packages coupled by gobwas/glob together - trivy and opa both require gobwas/glob v1.0.0, which removes glob.Glob that go.opentelemetry.io/collector/confmap still uses, so they must move in one PR once confmap migrates (opentelemetry-collector#15928)
Group Microsoft Kiota packages together
Group Microsoft Graph SDK packages together
Group Kubernetes SIG packages together
Group containerd packages together
Group Docker packages together
Group Moby packages together
Group Sigstore packages together
Enable indirect Go dependencies
Disable sarama updates - requires manual handling
Disable go.mod replace directive updates - pins must match beats go.mod; renovate writes invalid bare commit hashes
Disable goja updates - replaced by elastic/goja, version is driven by beats
Disable e2e-testing updates - v1.99.x tags are not real releases (latest is v1.2.3)

Disable go-ini/ini updates - v1.67.1+ declares its module path as gopkg.in/ini.v1, so 'go get github.com/go-ini/ini' fails; gopkg.in/ini.v1 is already used by trivy/opa/rekor, only yq still imports the old path. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule, which would otherwise re-enable it

Disable anchore/go-struct-converter updates - v0.2.x removes converter.ConvertFrom, which spdx/tools-golang (latest v0.5.7) still calls, breaking the build. Re-enable once spdx/tools-golang supports it. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule

Disable k8s.io/kube-openapi updates - newer digests require sigs.k8s.io/structured-merge-diff/v7, but k8s.io/apimachinery v0.37.x still uses v6, breaking the build. Re-enable once a stable k8s.io release (v0.38+) moves to v7. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule

Cap sigs.k8s.io/kustomize api and kyaml below v0.21.3 - v0.21.3 pulls in a newer k8s.io/kube-openapi and sigs.k8s.io/structured-merge-diff/v7, but k8s.io/apimachinery v0.37.x still uses v6 (cannot use ...structured-merge-diff/v7/schema.TypeDef as ...v6/schema.TypeDef). Re-enable once a stable k8s.io release (v0.38+) moves to v7. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule

Cap OPA below v1.21.0 - v1.21+ requires gobwas/glob v1.0.0, which removes glob.Glob and breaks go.opentelemetry.io/collector/confmap (undefined: glob.Glob). Re-enable once otel confmap migrates (opentelemetry-collector#15928) and beats picks it up. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule

Cap trivy below v0.76.0 - v0.76.0 requires opa v1.21.1 and gobwas/glob v1.0.0, which removes glob.Glob and breaks go.opentelemetry.io/collector/confmap (undefined: glob.Glob). Re-enable once otel confmap migrates (opentelemetry-collector#15928). Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule; the 9.4 trivy cap below is stricter and takes precedence there

Cap gobwas/glob below v1.0.0 - v1.0.0 replaces the glob.Glob interface with *glob.Pattern and breaks go.opentelemetry.io/collector/confmap (undefined: glob.Glob). Re-enable together with the trivy and OPA caps once otel confmap migrates (opentelemetry-collector#15928). Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule
Disable otelaws updates - v0.72.0 deprecates the package (staticcheck SA1019); we are in maintenance mode, so stay on v0.71.0. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule

Disable major updates for indirect Go dependencies - a major bump changes the module path (e.g. backoff/v6 to backoff/v7), which is not used by cloudbeat and is reverted by go mod tidy, so the Lint job fails on the non-empty git diff. They move when the direct dependent (trivy, beats, yq) moves. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule
Disable Azure SDK major updates - cloudbeat imports these packages directly, so a major bump breaks the build until the Azure fetchers are migrated. Do these by hand in a dedicated PR

9.4: disable elastic packages - they are coupled to the pinned elastic/beats (e.g. elastic-agent-libs v0.47.0 breaks libbeat: undefined paths.Paths), and beats cannot be bumped because newer beats requires Go 1.27. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule
9.4: disable beats branch tracking - the git-refs manager is not covered by the gomod rule above, and newer beats requires Go 1.27, which 9.4 does not move to
9.4: cap trivy below v0.75.0 - v0.75.0 requires Go 1.27, which 9.4 does not move to. Patch updates within 0.74.x still flow
9.4: cap fluxcd/cli-utils below v1.4.0 - v1.4.0 requires Go 1.27, which 9.4 does not move to
9.4: cap sigstore/sigstore below v1.11.0 - v1.11.0 requires Go 1.27, which 9.4 does not move to

9.4: cap sigstore/rekor below v1.5.5 - v1.5.5 raises go.mod to go 1.27, which 9.4 does not move to. Patch updates within 1.5.x up to v1.5.4 still flow. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule
9.4: disable moby updates - the bumps raise go.mod to go 1.26.8 while 9.4 CI runs Go 1.26.6, and they are indirect-only. Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule

9.4: stay on Go 1.26.6 - no Go 1.27 upgrade is planned on this branch, and the hermit go package has no 1.26.7+ (go.hcl in cashapp/hermit-packages stops at 1.26.6), so a go.mod bump to 1.26.7+ cannot pass CI. Raise the cap once hermit adds them
Auto-merge minor, patch, digest, and pin updates for all packages

elastic/beats git-refs updates have no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge with internalChecksFilter strict would hold them back forever. Must stay after the 'Auto-merge minor, patch, digest, and pin updates' rule, which would otherwise re-apply minimumReleaseAge

Hermit go and golangci-lint updates have no release timestamp (the hermit datasource does not provide one), so minimumReleaseAge with internalChecksFilter strict holds them out of the go-version group branch and the PR only bumps go.mod, which fails CI because the toolchain comes from hermit (bin/.go-*.pkg). Must stay after the 'Auto-merge minor, patch, digest, and pin updates' rule, which would otherwise re-apply minimumReleaseAge

Exempt the .go-version and docs/version.asciidoc regex managers from minimumReleaseAge like the hermit entries. With internalChecksFilter strict they appear to be held out of the go-version group branch for a new Go release (go 1.27.3: the PRs bumped go.mod and the hermit pin but not .go-version or docs), leaving the PR inconsistent. Must stay after the 'Auto-merge minor, patch, digest, and pin updates' rule, which would otherwise re-apply minimumReleaseAge
Manual review for major updates

Disable go-pep440-version and trivy-checks updates - they are indirect pseudo-version deps pinned by trivy's go.mod, so the version moves with trivy. Renovate cannot resolve a new digest for them (package lookup failure). Must stay after the 'Enable indirect Go dependencies' rule
Disable stefanprodan/kube-tools updates - the repo is archived and its floating 'v1' ref is a branch, not a tag, so Renovate cannot resolve a new digest (package lookup failure)

Disable python image updates in tests/Dockerfile - the lookup for python:3.15-slim fails with 'timeout while waiting for mutex to become available' (lookupUpdates error on the Dependency Dashboard). Re-enable once the lookup works again

Disable the kustomize 'elastic-agent' image update in the vanilla-agent overlay - newName is a bare local image name (loaded into kind), which Renovate resolves as docker.io/library/elastic-agent and fails with 'no-result' (package lookup failure)
Disable elastic/oblt-actions updates - only used by backport-active.yml, which is kept for the backport-active-* labels but is a candidate for deprecation

Group the remaining Go minor, patch and digest updates into one PR per branch (replaces the single-package docker, moby, sigstore, kiota, graph, gcp and containerd PRs). Packages that are coupled by a dedicated group above, and the go toolchain, are excluded. Majors stay separate. Must stay after the dedicated group rules so it overrides their groupName
Group GitHub Actions minor, patch and digest updates
Group Python (poetry) library minor and patch updates. The python interpreter version is excluded because it needs its own review
Disable digest updates for volatile packages
Allow minor Go version updates in go.mod

Group hermit-managed dev tools (awscli, terraform, gh, yq, ...) into one PR per branch and update type instead of one dashboard entry each. Must stay before the 'go-version' group rule, so go and golangci-lint keep their own group
Group Go toolchain and golangci-lint version updates together
Cap regal below v1 - the upstream repo has stray v2.x tags (e.g. v2.2.3, a 2024 'Testing versioning' commit) that are not releases and break the pre-commit hook install. Real releases are v0.x
Group pre-commit hook rev updates into one PR
Disable CI/infrastructure/test-environment updates on release branches
Disable hermit dev tool updates on release branches (maintenance mode). go and golangci-lint are re-enabled by the next rule because their go.mod and hermit pin bumps must land together
Keep go and golangci-lint hermit updates on release branches. Must stay after the 'Disable hermit dev tool updates on release branches' rule
8.19: stay on the 8.x elastic-agent image - the v9 bump is not valid for this branch
8.19: disable gopkg.in/yaml.v2 major update - v3 changes behavior and needs a manual migration, which is not planned in maintenance mode
Disable terraform provider and module major updates - they only affect test environments and need hand-tested upgrades. Do them in a dedicated PR
